_note: N6 findings — gaugeHits blindness in refill-starvation and gauge-sources folds. QUEUE N6 (2026-08-17). Code audit, no engine or override was changed.
question: Do the --refill-starvation and --multihit-crediting folds carry the same gaugeHits blindness that was fixed in the credit-schedule fold?

refillStarvation.verdict: LATENT — code pattern is wrong, but no gaugeHits carrier is seated in any audited comp
refillStarvation.defect: The hit-counting loop (fb-count-matrix.ts ~line 430) counts every damage event with bucket 'skill'/'burst' as ONE gauge-eligible hit. A flatDamage with gaugeHits: N fires skillGauge N times but emits only ONE damage event, so the fold counts 1 hit where the engine credited N gauge impacts.
affectedQuantities: hits[] per bucket (under-counted by (N-1) per gaugeHits impact)
first1sRatio (biased if a gaugeHits carrier fires early in a refill window)
refillStarvation.note: Only comps with measuredPeriodSec defined are audited (2 of 9). Neither seats snow-white-heavy-arms, eve, or little-mermaid (the three gaugeHits carriers). The defect has zero output impact on current results.

gaugeSources.verdict: LIVE — N5 snowwhite-HA fire seats snow-white-heavy-arms (gaugeHits 5/10)
gaugeSources.defect: Same counting pattern (fb-count-matrix.ts ~line 1210): counts damage events as unlocked impacts. snow-white-heavy-arms reports 52 unlocked impacts but each S1(b) volley fires gaugeHits 5, so the actual gauge-credit count is higher. The census correctly reports that the emission PATH is present, but under-counts the number of gauge credits the path delivers.
gaugeSources.magnitude: snow-white-heavy-arms: 52 counted impacts vs an unknown true gauge-credit count (depends on the volley/AoE ratio during refill windows). The census's PURPOSE is path verification (is the emission kind present?), not total counting, so the under-count may be acceptable for its stated goal.
gaugeSources.note: The gauge-sources audit runs on ALL 9 OFF comps, not just the 2 with measuredPeriodSec.

multihitCrediting.verdict: NO DEFECT — reads engine gaugeGenerated, does not count damage instances
multihitCrediting.explanation: The multihit-crediting fold (fb-count-matrix.ts ~line 1508) calls run() and reads res.units[].gaugeGenerated, totalDamage, pulls. It compares gauge AMOUNTS between baseline and trigger arms, never counting events. The gaugeHits fix in the engine is upstream of this fold and flows through correctly.
multihitCrediting.correctionToQueue: QUEUE N6's description states 'the sibling --refill-starvation and --multihit-crediting folds count damage instances as gauge-eligible hits.' This is accurate for --refill-starvation but NOT for --multihit-crediting. The multihit fold is clean.

fixScope.refillStarvation: Import or inline skillGaugeHits() from the credit-schedule fold and multiply per-event hit counts. Low urgency (latent).
fixScope.gaugeSources: Same fix. Higher urgency (live on N5) but the census's purpose is path verification, not total counting, so the under-count may be acceptable. Owner call.
